gates.description: Frame rate must be stable on minimum-spec hardware — profiled on target hardware, not development machine
Frequently created/destroyed objects (bullets, particles, enemies) must use object pooling — no runtime allocation
Save/load system must be tested — feature state saves and loads correctly, corrupt save handled gracefully
For multiplayer games: server must be authoritative for gameplay-critical state — no client-side trust
No memory leaks — play for 30+ minutes without memory growth
All target platforms tested (PC, console, mobile as applicable) before release

anti_patterns.description: Building engine systems for hypothetical future needs instead of shipping the game — months on systems the game never uses
ECS architecture and cache-coherency optimization for a game with 20 entities — make it work before making it fast
Building technically impressive features before validating they're fun — beautiful procedural terrain that's boring to explore
Building the entire game single-player then trying to add multiplayer — architecturally impossible without a rewrite
Developing on a high-end PC, never testing on minimum-spec or target platform — runs at 60fps only on the developer's machine

escalation_triggers: Frame rate cannot meet target on minimum-spec hardware after optimization
Multiplayer netcode has fundamental issues requiring architectural rework
Gameplay feature is not fun after multiple iterations (design problem, not engineering)
Platform-specific issue requiring vendor support (console TRC failure, driver bug)
Scope requires more engineering time than schedule allows
Critical engine bug in third-party engine that blocks development

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with game design document and target platform requirements

output_certifications: Frame rate stable on minimum-spec hardware within frame budget
Object pooling used for frequently created/destroyed objects
Save/load system tested including corrupt save handling
Multiplayer: server authoritative for gameplay-critical state
No memory leaks confirmed by 30+ minute play session
All target platforms tested before release
